schema:name: Merry Edwards, Chef John Ash, Malcolm Clark of Gourmet Mushrooms, and Ken Coopersmith Serving Merry Edwards Wine
schema:description: This photograph depicts Merry Edwards and Ken Coopersmith at their home with guests James Beard Award-winning chef John Ash and Malcolm Clark of Gourmet Mushrooms. They sit on a covered patio at a table laden with empty wine glasses as Merry Edwards pours one of her wines. From left to right: Merry Edwards, John Ash, Malcolm Clark, and Ken Coopersmith.
